title: Reimbursement Ledger Rule — Recoupment of a Paid Mobility Equipment Line
content:
# Recoupment of a Paid Line — Mobility Equipment

**Rule.** A payer recoupment on Mobility Equipment is recorded against the one paid line it takes back, as the original line, one reversal per line named in the payer's letter; a paid line is reversed at most once. A reversed rental month leaves the paid count; every patient charge stemming from the reversed line is removed under the Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility rules.

## Reading the rule

- **One line, one reversal.** Each reversal names exactly one paid line. A payer's letter naming three lines gives three reversals.
- **At most once.** Whether a line has already been reversed is read from the system's billing records: a reversal already recorded against that line means it is not reversed again.
- **Effect on the count.** A reversed rental month no longer counts among the paid months of the rental period.
- **Effect on the patient.** Every patient charge stemming from the reversed line is removed.

## Hypothetical illustration

A payer's letter takes back rental months 4 and 5 of a chair. Two reversals are recorded, one against the paid line of month 4 and one against the paid line of month 5; the paid count falls by two, and the patient charges that came from those two lines are removed. A second letter naming month 4 again does not produce another reversal of that line.
